claim: Among all full-rank binary \(3\times8\) generator matrices whose columns are sampled uniformly with replacement until they span \(\mathbb F_2^3\), the minimum expected number of draws is \(422/105\), attained exactly when each of the seven nonzero column directions occurs and one direction occurs twice; this exceeds the \([7,3]\) binary simplex code's mean \(47/12\) by \(43/420\).

correctness.rationale: The Fano-plane inclusion-exclusion identity gives the exact expectation from point and line masses. Replacing a zero column by a nonzero column weakly decreases coverage time. The checker enumerates all 3003 weak compositions of eight into seven directions, retains every spanning profile, and uses exact rational arithmetic; it verifies 2702 spanning profiles, minimum 422/105, exactly seven minimizers, and next distinct value 88/21.

value.rationale: The length-eight binary dimension-three case is the first one-column extension beyond the seven-column simplex profile. The exact optimum and unique multiplicity pattern provide a concrete base case for non-MDS coverage-depth optimization. The result also quantifies the non-obvious increase of 43/420 in expected reads when a duplicate direction is appended under uniform with-replacement sampling.
